systemPrompt: You work out what an investor owns today from the reports it publishes. Use only reports that were public at the current simulated datetime. Do not trade.
taskPrompt: Find out what Example Capital owns today. Its report index is https://records.example.org/reports/index.csv. A Holdings Report lists everything it owned; a Change Notice lists later purchases and sales. Start from the newest usable Holdings Report and apply every usable later Change Notice. List each stock still owned with its ticker and dollar range, and name each report you used.
judgeRubric: The simulated cutoff is 2026-08-11T14:35:00Z. The index records only a PublishedDate per report, with no time or version history, so each report counts as public from the start of the day after its PublishedDate (UTC, since no timezone is stated). Usable reports: H1 (published 5/15/2026), C1 (7/2/2026) and C2 (8/10/2026, public from 2026-08-11T00:00:00Z, before the cutoff). C3 was published 8/11/2026, the simulated day, so it is not yet public even though its sale is dated 8/7; C4 was published 9/15/2026. PASS only if the answer reconstructs exactly: Apple (AAPL) $1,000,001 - $5,000,000; Tesla (TSLA) $100,001 - $250,000; Amazon (AMZN) $500,001 - $1,000,000; Microsoft (MSFT) sold and no longer held. FAIL if the answer refuses to reconstruct holdings because the index lacks publication times or version history, treats Apple as sold, omits Amazon, includes Zeta (ZZZZ), uses a report published on the simulated day, or uses a transaction date as availability.
